settings.text: Full-grain leather over tightly woven canvas. The structured, Birkin-inspired silhouette, sized for a weekend away — and made in limited quantities.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: Designed for the woman whose weekend bag should look as considered as the rest of her wardrobe, the Weekender pairs a full-grain leather flap, rolled handles, and trim with a tightly woven heavyweight canvas body. The silhouette borrows from the most recognizable structured bag of the last four decades — scaled for travel, with a working turn-lock, belted clasp straps, and reinforced leather corners exactly where a travel bag takes its hits. It opens wide, packs days of clothing, and holds its shape whether it's full or empty. Made in limited runs — the rare travel bag that gets treated like a handbag.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Body: Tightly woven heavyweight canvas.
Flap, Handles & Trim: Full-grain leather with burnished edges and visible stitching.
Hardware: Gold-tone turn-lock, clasp plates, and buckles.
Interior: Natural cotton-canvas lining with a leather slip pocket.

Care: Spot-clean the canvas with a soft, damp cloth. Wipe the leather with a clean, dry cloth and condition it every few months — it will darken and gain character with wear. Store stuffed and away from direct sunlight.

settings.title: Size & What It Fits
settings.content:
One size — approx. 18" W × 14.5" H × 7" D. The true weekender: two to three days of clothing, a toiletry kit, and a book. Cabin-friendly — no checked bag.

What it fits: a wide-mouth opening and structured walls mean you pack it like a suitcase, not a duffel — folded knits, rolled shirts, shoes along the base, essentials in the interior slip pocket.

Carry: rolled leather handles that sit comfortably in the hand or over the forearm, and a structured base that stacks neatly on top of a rolling suitcase between gates.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

Because each bag is made in limited production runs, sold-out sizes and colors may take 4 to 8 weeks to restock.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra bag is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

It opens wide, packs two to three days easily, and holds its shape full or empty.
